name: first-principles fix: TWO framings vs newest-ML (R14)
diagnosis: VIABLE = novel AND useful AND undone. 'newest-ML' contradicts 'undone' by construction. Fix the INPUT, not the checkers.

framing_A_mature_ML.method: FalconHMM: latent {over-sharp/sharp/comfortable/heavy} states, multi-channel emissions (weight-delta, behavior score), Viterbi + Baum-Welch per bird
GPick: GP posterior over pin force-vs-height, GP-UCB selects next probe; sequential Bayesian pin-state estimation

KhipuHMM: 5-channel emissions (knot-type/ply/color/fiber/attachment) -> latent register states; Viterbi-decode; trainable on Open Khipu Repository (~650 khipus); test latent-register log-lik gap accounting-vs-narrative
framing_A_mature_ML.note: real trainable dataset + open scholarly problem

framing_A_mature_ML.method: KintsugiKalman: forward the RTS-smoother POSTERIOR VARIANCE as a downstream 'scar feature' [imputed, scar_variance, gap_distance] instead of discarding it; test on gap-injection fault-detection

framing_B_new_problem.problem: BAND-DWELL CONTROL: drive a LATENT readiness state into a narrow band, HOLD under timing uncertainty, then MANDATORILY WITHDRAW before an uncertain trigger. 4-way conjunction (band-dwell objective + latent state + mandatory withdrawal + uncertain trigger).
framing_B_new_problem.nearest: titration/dosing RL (but that's sustained maintenance, no withdrawal, fixed trigger)

framing_B_new_problem.problem: Learn an elementary ATTACHMENT MICRO-RULE whose iterated application makes single-element removal NON-cascading by construction (damage-non-propagation as an EMERGENT generative invariant, not a post-hoc robustness penalty).
framing_B_new_problem.nearest: cascade-resilient graph design (operates on fixed graphs; predicts/mitigates, doesn't generate the invariant)

framing_B_new_problem.problem: VALUE-SUPERADDITIVE REPAIR: learn a repair fn whose output V(repaired) > V(original) where the visible damage-history is the SOURCE of surplus value (not restoration-to-baseline).
framing_B_new_problem.nearest: inpainting/restoration (minimize dist-to-original); Si-Kintsugi (recovers toward baseline, not beyond)

framing_B_new_problem.problem: REPRESENTATIONAL COLONIZATION RESISTANCE: robustness via PRIOR OCCUPANCY (full capacity leaves no niche for spurious features) not active defense; a 'colonization-susceptibility' metric measurable pre-finetuning.
framing_B_new_problem.nearest: spurious-feature/shortcut learning + pretraining-for-robustness (active-suppression view, no occupancy/niche formalization)

headline_measurement_generator_level: Framing A: 4/4 COMBO_UNDONE. Framing B: 4/4 PROBLEM_UNFORMULATED. vs newest-ML (epochs 1-4): ~0/8 undone (everything reduced to existing). STRONG support for the first-principles diagnosis AT THE GENERATION LEVEL.
